target.name: ascend950pr
target.notes: Validated arch35 AIV limits: EVENT_ID0..3 and 256 KiB UB, of which at most 216 KiB is usable for tensors after the 8 KiB compiler reserve and 32 KiB SIMT DataCache floor. Pipeline timing remains uncalibrated, so performance advisories are withheld.

diagnostics.title: Unpaired SetFlag / WaitFlag
diagnostics.message: 12 SetFlag<MTE2_S>(EVENT_ID0) outside any loop but only 10 matching WaitFlag; the extra priming flags are never drained, leaking hardware event slots
diagnostics.remediation: Add 2 draining AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_S>(EVENT_ID0); after the loop, matching the priming SetFlag calls before it.

diagnostics.title: Flag set twice without an intervening wait
diagnostics.message: SetFlag<MTE2_S>(EVENT_ID0) is raised again before the pending flag from line 1133 is consumed; the event counter can saturate
diagnostics.remediation: Insert the matching WaitFlag between the two SetFlag calls, or give the second one a distinct EVENT_ID so the two dependencies are tracked separately.

diagnostics.title: Unpaired SetFlag / WaitFlag
diagnostics.message: 10 SetFlag<MTE2_S>(EVENT_ID2) outside any loop but only 8 matching WaitFlag; the extra priming flags are never drained, leaking hardware event slots
diagnostics.remediation: Add 2 draining AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE2_S>(EVENT_ID2); after the loop, matching the priming SetFlag calls before it.

diagnostics.title: Flag set twice without an intervening wait
diagnostics.message: SetFlag<MTE2_S>(EVENT_ID2) is raised again before the pending flag from line 1134 is consumed; the event counter can saturate
diagnostics.remediation: Insert the matching WaitFlag between the two SetFlag calls, or give the second one a distinct EVENT_ID so the two dependencies are tracked separately.
